Manifest.Name: Precision Mixer / 精密配比机
Manifest.Author: XuFly
Manifest.Description: Metered mixing toward a target percentage. Chemical modules improve dose resolution from 10mL to 1µL (max 4; locked after installation). No battery needed. Base value 350. GPL-3.0-only; see LICENSE and NOTICE. English / 中文. 化学模组提升实际定量配比精度：10mL至1µL，最多4个，安装后锁定。无需电池，基础价值350。请备份存档，卸载前取出瓶子并处理掉机器。
